startup.bilibiliQuality.p1: The quality of Bilibili video downloads depends on whether you are signed in via the QR code login, and on your premium account level. Without signing in, only up to 480P is available; after signing in, 1080P is usually available.
startup.bilibiliQuality.p2: The button at the top right of the Bilibili page shows the current login status: "QR Login" means you are not signed in, or the previous login has expired; "Signed In" means no re-login is needed.
startup.bilibiliQuality.p3: Downloads always pick the highest quality profile available.
startup.bilibiliQuality.title: Bilibili download quality depends on login status
startup.flac.p1: Lossless files with an unusually large size in music search results may simply be upsampled to inflate the file size; the extra size carries no useful information. This comes from the source site's files and cannot be fixed by this tool; judge whether to download by size and duration yourself.
startup.flac.p2: You can also turn on the "Auto Refine" switch next to the Music page title: after a download finishes, audio above 48 kHz is automatically downsampled to 48 kHz. Due to API limitations, detection is not guaranteed to be accurate, and a few official releases above 48 kHz may be affected; weigh the trade-offs yourself.
startup.flac.title: Oversized FLAC files may be "fake lossless"
startup.proxy.p1: The system proxy setting determines which IP the app uses for its requests.
startup.proxy.p2: For downloads from Mainland China servers (e.g. Bilibili videos or Mainland China music sources), disabling the proxy is recommended; for downloads from overseas servers (e.g. YouTube or overseas music sources), enabling the proxy is recommended.
startup.proxy.p3: If your proxy app runs in TUN mode, all traffic goes through the proxy; disable TUN mode when downloading from Mainland China servers.
startup.proxy.title: Toggle the system proxy based on the data source
startup.title: Getting Started
